description: This file defines classes for simulating input devices such as Keyboard, Mouse, and Touchscreen in a browser automation context, including methods for performing actions like pressing keys, clicking, moving the mouse, and tapping.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Represents a keyboard interface, providing methods to simulate key presses, text insertion, and typing.

classes.name: Mouse
classes.description: Represents a mouse interface, enabling movement, clicking, double-clicking, and wheel scrolling.

classes.name: Touchscreen
classes.description: Represents a touchscreen interface, supporting tap actions.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Presses down a specified key on the keyboard.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Releases a specified key on the keyboard.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Inserts text at the current cursor position.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text with optional delay or configuration.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key with optional modifiers.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse to specified coordinates.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs a mouse click at given coordinates.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Performs a double click at given coordinates.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Scrolls the mouse wheel by specified delta values.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap action at specified coordinates on a touchscreen.
